one_line: Jain poet of the Hoysala Kannada age and author of Yashodhara Charite.

appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Kannada complexion, straight nose, neat short beard and moustache, calm thoughtful eyes; default expression is gentle, introspective focus with a hint of compassion
appearance.hair: deep black hair, parted slightly off-center, medium length to just above shoulders, smoothly combed back and tied into a low knot; simple off-white cloth headband tied at the back
appearance.costume: a modest, finely woven off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf with neat front pleats and a dark maroon narrow border, paired with a light cream long-sleeved angarakha-style upper garment crossing left over right and tied with thin cloth cords, plus a soft pale yellow cotton shawl draped over both shoulders and falling evenly to mid-thigh; simple leather sandals and no elaborate jewellery save a single small copper ring on his right hand to keep him visually modest and unadorned in Jain fashion
appearance.signature: a rectangular palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin red cord, held carefully in both hands or tucked under his left arm

ref_desc: Janna is a mid-30s slim Jain poet with an oval medium-brown face, short beard, black shoulder-length tied hair with an off-white headband, wearing off-white dhoti, cream angarakha, pale yellow shawl, dark maroon border and carrying a tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle.
sheet_prompt: Full-body character sheet of Janna, a mid-30s slim Jain poet from Hoysala-era Karnataka, in anime style but historically grounded: oval medium-brown face, straight nose, short neat beard and moustache, calm thoughtful eyes; black hair to just above shoulders, combed back into a low knot, with an off-white cloth headband tied at the back. He wears an off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf with crisp front pleats and a dark maroon narrow border, a light cream long-sleeved angarakha-style upper garment crossing left over right and tied by thin cloth cords, and a pale yellow cotton shawl draped symmetrically over both shoulders, hanging to mid-thigh. Feet in simple brown leather sandals, only a small copper ring on his right hand, no other jewellery. He holds a rectangular palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin red cord, sometimes cradled in both hands, sometimes tucked under his left arm. Show him front, side, and back, maintaining the off-white, cream, dark maroon, pale yellow, and black palette and consistent proportions and costume details.
